Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks retreat as oil crosses $100, yields rise ahead of inflation data
Markets.summary: US stocks fell on Wednesday as Brent crude surpassed $100 a barrel and Treasury yields rose. Investors grew increasingly concerned about inflation and the possibility of a Federal Reserve rate hike ahead of upcoming economic data.

Markets.title: Barclays raises S&P 500 year-end target to 7,950 on strong earnings
Markets.summary: Barclays raised its year-end S&P 500 target to 7,950, citing strong corporate earnings and ongoing artificial intelligence investments. The brokerage expects this earnings momentum to continue despite ongoing inflation, geopolitical risks, and interest rate concerns.

Markets.title: ICICI Prudential AMC gets RBI approval to buy up to 9.95% stake in Kotak and 3 other banks
Markets.summary: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company received RBI approval to acquire up to a 9.95 percent stake in Kotak Mahindra Bank, AU Small Finance Bank, CSB Bank, and DCB Bank. The mutual fund schemes managed by the company will hold these shares as investments.

Markets.title: US stocks calm ahead of midterm polls, but markets may be underpricing the risk
Markets.summary: US stocks are near record highs ahead of the midterm elections with the VIX volatility index near 15. Analysts warn that this unusually low market volatility and limited demand for protection mean investors may be underestimating potential risks.

Markets.title: RBL Bank raises $350 million in debut international bond sale
Markets.summary: RBL Bank raised $350 million in its first international bond sale by pricing bonds tighter than initial guidance due to strong investor demand. The capital will fund GIFT City growth and liability management, with backing from Emirates NBD strengthening its credit quality.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets fell for the third consecutive day, with the Sensex dropping 813 points and the Nifty losing 204 points. The decline was driven by soaring oil prices and rising Middle East tensions that triggered broad-based selling and wiped out over Rs 2 lakh crore in BSE market capitalization.

Geo-Political.title: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge
Geo-Political.summary: Declassified documents reveal that Spanish and Moroccan authorities were warned via social media about a planned mass migrant crossing into Ceuta. This warning occurred the day before tens of thousands of people entered the Spanish enclave.

Geo-Political.title: Google picks Finland for its largest single investment in Europe
Geo-Political.summary: Google is investing €13 billion to build its largest European data center in Finland. The project is expected to create tens of thousands of jobs.

Geo-Political.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
Geo-Political.summary: Global oil benchmark Brent crude reached $100 a barrel for the first time since July following recent US and Houthi strikes. The price increase occurred after the United States military struck five Iranian tankers on Tuesday.

Geo-Political.title: Iran referred to UN Security Council for nuclear non-compliance
Geo-Political.summary: Iran has been referred to the UN Security Council for non-compliance with its nuclear obligations. Tehran condemned the resolution, blaming US and Israeli strikes on its nuclear facilities for disrupting inspections.

Geo-Political.title: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win
Geo-Political.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz clashed with AfD leader Alice Weidel during a stormy parliamentary debate following the far-right party's recent election victory. Merz criticized the AfD's migration policy, arguing that it amounts to "ethnic cleansing" for skilled workers.

Geo-Political.title: US to ban imports of some Canadian alcohol, dairy goods and motorbikes
Geo-Political.summary: The United States is banning imports of specific Canadian alcohol, dairy products, and motorbikes. This action is the newest escalation in an ongoing trade war, following Canada's implementation of counter-tariffs on American goods.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without using paid advertising. This experiment demonstrated how artificial intelligence search optimization is shifting organic traffic generation away from traditional SEO.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These digital tools help content creators streamline their workflows and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights 10 advanced artificial intelligence tools designed to automate repetitive tasks and improve workplace efficiency. These widely used applications help streamline workflows and increase productivity across various industries.

Data & Insights.title: Goyal bats for common Brics trade platform, women-focused fund
Data & Insights.summary: India's commerce minister proposed a common BRICS trade platform and a women-focused fund during a speech in New Delhi. He made these remarks at the BRICS Women's Business Alliance Women-Led Development Conference ahead of the group's summit.

Data & Insights.title: India-Thailand trade talks focus on market access, Asean trade agreement review
Data & Insights.summary: India and Thailand have agreed to a time-bound review of their Asean trade agreement to address India's expanding trade deficit, which reached $10.81 billion in 2025. Both countries also pledged to improve market access and strengthen business-to-business linkages to foster balanced economic growth.

Data & Insights.title: Brent crosses $100 as West Asia war raises pressure on India’s economy
Data & Insights.summary: Brent crude prices surpassed $100 per barrel due to the escalating conflict in West Asia. This increase threatens to raise India's oil import bill, leading to higher inflation and fiscal challenges.

Data & Insights.title: Cabinet clears  ₹10,783 crore rail expansion as key corridors near capacity
Data & Insights.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved a ₹10,783 crore railway expansion project covering 655 kilometers to ease network congestion. The three multi-tracking projects will increase freight capacity by 26.69 million tonnes per annum while creating jobs and reducing emissions.

Data & Insights.title: BJP’s war chest grew  ₹905 crore during 2026 polls, Congress’ shrank  ₹66 crore: What EC data reveals
Data & Insights.summary: Election Commission data shows the BJP's financial war chest grew by ₹905 crore during the 2021 assembly elections. In contrast, the Congress party reported net receipts of ₹207.17 crore and an expenditure of ₹248.55 crore during the same period, causing its funds to shrink by ₹66 crore.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | How has LPG supply eased for second-largest global buyer of domestic cooking gas?
Data & Insights.summary: India eased its LPG supply crunch for 340 million consumers by shifting imports to the US and new suppliers while increasing domestic production. Government booking relaxations and diversification efforts also helped stabilize cooking gas availability.

India.title: Guwahati Police Seize Fridge Used To Store Woman's Severed Head
India.summary: Guwahati police seized a refrigerator used to store the severed head of a murdered woman. Her husband, Ramanuj Goswami, was brought to the house as part of the investigation.

India.title: Assam Official Arrested Over Scam, Used Mimics To Impersonate Chief Minister
India.summary: Assam official Debeswar Sharma was arrested by the Chief Minister's Special Vigilance Cell in a multi-crore cheating and corruption case. He allegedly used voice mimics to impersonate the Chief Minister during the scam.

India.title: Arvind Kejriwal Unanimously Re-Elected As AAP National Convener
India.summary: Arvind Kejriwal was unanimously re-elected as the national convener of the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP). During the meeting, Kejriwal and other senior leaders discussed the party's future strategy with members.

India.title: 'National Award Not Any State's Property': Gujarat BJP Slams Uddhav Thackeray
India.summary: Gujarat BJP chief spokesperson Dr Anil Patel stated that films from all over India compete for National Awards. He made this remark in response to Uddhav Thackeray, emphasizing that the honors do not belong to any single state.

India.title: Apple iPhone Launch Event Live Updates: Apple Launches First Foldable iPhone, Gives Hat-Tip To iPad
India.summary: Apple has launched its first foldable iPhone during a major event. The presentation was led by new CEO John Ternus following his handover from Tim Cook.

India.title: Tamil Nadu's Ruling Alliance Gets A Name, Flags Secularism, Social Justice
India.summary: Tamil Nadu's ruling alliance has adopted a new name that emphasizes secularism and social justice. VCK leader SS Balaji stated that Chief Minister Vijay came up with the idea for the name.

General.title: Police launch criminal investigation into Reform UK donations
General.summary: Police have launched a criminal investigation into donations made to Reform UK. This inquiry follows a Channel 4 News broadcast and is now part of an existing investigation into other donations.

General.title: Air traffic failure was avoidable, says transport secretary
General.summary: Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander stated that a technical glitch causing over 2,000 flight cancellations was avoidable. She has ordered an official investigation into the incident.

General.summary: The UK has accused the Israeli government of ignoring the ethnic cleansing of Palestinians by settlers in the West Bank. The muted US response to the UK's subsequent sanctions may reflect growing frustration between the two allies.
